articles.title: ZDI-26-1030: (0Day) G DATA Total Security TSNxGService Link Following Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
articles.context: An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability
articles.full_text:
Vulnerability Details

This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of G DATA Total Security. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the TSNxGService service. By creating a symbolic link, an attacker can abuse the service to delete a file. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM.

Additional Details

02/12/26 - ZDI reported the vulnerability to the vendor02/13/26 - the vendor acknowledged the receipt of the report03/02/26 - the vendor confirmed the reported issue06/15/26 - ZDI asked for updates06/24/26 – the vendor communicated that the fix was in progress 08/10/26 - ZDI asked for updates08/12/26 - the vendor confirmed the fix had no release estimate08/25/26 - ZDI notified the vendor of the intention to publish the case as a 0-day advisory

-- Mitigation: Given the nature of the vulnerability, the only salient mitigation strategy is to restrict interaction with the product

Disclosure Timeline

2026-02-12 - Vulnerability reported to vendor

2026-11-18 - Coordinated public release of advisory
